newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistani stocks tumble on political uncertainty.
newsitem.headline: Pakistani stocks tumble on political uncertainty.

text.p: Pakistani stocks tumbled on Monday as investors, wary of political uncertainty before general elections on February 3, offloaded blue chips and dealers predicted the market to open weaker on Tuesday.
"Things as they look today on the political front are a complete mess," dealer Salman Ahmad of Finex Securities said, adding that no major investor was likely to move in until after the elections.
The Karachi Stock Exchange 100-share index fell 20.98 points, or 1.52 percent, to end at 1,356.03. Losers led gainers 154 to 46.
